g.text: Phase 1: The admin creates an account
Check the email / username is free
Phase 2: Create the course & assign the teacher
Phase 3: The staff uploads the material
Validate the .md (valid, not empty, right size)
Phase 4: AI generates questions from the material
Phase 5: The staff reviews the questions
Validate the slot (no overlap, inside the exam period)
- validates the schedule and the maximum headcount
- allocates the paper and the invigilation slot
